overview: On the tables you wrote that the king stays in Shoreditch, and that you are to say nothing of the three leaves. You did not say the line aloud.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the line, and closed his hand on the tables.

assets.name: Richard II
assets.disposition: Wrote that the king stays in Shoreditch

summary: Wrote that the king stays in Shoreditch
